note.zh: 35 的选项：A 易猎物（排外/军国/灭绝倾向）→ 永久狩猎加成；B 研究 → 研究项目；C 共存（重视他者/和平/驯兽师）→ 安抚项目。
note.en: Options of 35: A prey → permanent hunting bonus; B study → study project; C coexist → pacification project.

note.zh: 研究项目完成：永久“晶体专注”（+5%能量）并给予晶体装甲科技选项与进度。
note.en: Study project: permanent crystal-focus modifier (+5% energy) and the crystal-armor research option with progress.

note.zh: 安抚项目完成：永久“被安抚的晶体”修正，并给予晶体装甲科技选项。
note.en: Pacification project: permanent pacified-crystals modifier and the crystal-armor option.

notes.zh: 审阅注：35 的 after 块在结束首次接触后，会向本方发出 grand_archive.200（水晶国家 FromFrom=本星系），属大档案（Grand Archive）篇章。
notes.en: Review note: the after block of 35 also fires grand_archive.200 for the owner (crystal country, current system) — a Grand Archive follow-up.

scope.en: Crystal first contact: 2 events, 2 projects and their 2 result events.
